critique.diagnosis: The AI pipeline has failed to completely remove all furniture and has introduced significant quality degradation in the process. The most critical failure is leaving visible furniture remnants (pillow/bedding on windowsill, electronic device, and ghosting shadows). The inpainting algorithm appears to have struggled with the large area occupied by the bed, resulting in heavy blur and texture inconsistency in the center of the room. The floor reconstruction is particularly poor, with smudged carpet texture that doesn't match the original's sharpness. Additionally, the pipeline has incorrectly identified and removed some of the hanging photos on the wall, which should have been preserved as permanent architectural elements. The quality degradation suggests insufficient resolution in the inpainting model or poor blending between original and generated regions.
